status: WRITTEN_BEFORE_COUNTING — the census run (census_run.py) loads and hashes this file before computing any count; the sha256 of this file at count time is recorded in downtrend_census.json

panel.loader: scored.cells.load_btc_h4 convention imported VERBATIM read-only from the PSV1 integration scored namespace (sys.path insert of the scored package dir; sys.dont_write_bytecode=True so the read-only tree is not modified). This loader re-derives labels via pipeline.phase_rule.classify and truncates the warmup via pipeline.census.era_fold_assignment exactly as PSV1 used.

labels.primary: DOWNTREND from PSV1 pipeline.phase_rule.classify with frozen config (N_SMA=120, M_SLOPE=30, DEADBAND_SLOPE=0.01, DEADBAND_SIDE=0.01, CONFIRM=3, WARMUP=153 H4 bars). Code-owned PIT: all inputs at t use bars with close time <= decision time t; the confirmation window uses raw states at t-CONFIRM+1..t. No future bars, no tops/bottoms, no outcome data.
labels.secondary_lens: close < SMA200(H4), SMA200 = causal rolling mean of the H4 close over the prior 200 H4 bars inclusive of t (PSV1 TREND_LF convention, inverse side). Lens is valid from panel index >= 199 (its own warmup); agreement with the primary label is reported on the overlap only. The lens is a ROBUSTNESS REPORT, not a replacement: no choice between lenses is made by this lane.
labels.causality_statement: Both labels are causal at decision time: computed from bars with close time <= decision time. Decision at H4 close; first executable fill at the NEXT H4 bucket open (PSV1 EXECUTION_LAW). No future tops/bottoms or outcome data are used anywhere in this census.

window.definition: post-warmup buckets of the staged panel: panel index >= WARMUP(153), i.e. bucket open >= 2020-01-26 12:00 UTC, through the last staged bucket (open 2026-09-22 20:00 UTC).
window.warmup_treatment: warmup buckets are used for indicator computation but excluded from all counts (PSV1 convention: truncated, not refused).

episode_definition.run: maximal contiguous run of bars with label == DOWNTREND (primary) or lens-true (secondary) inside the window
episode_definition.censoring: runs touching the window start/end are retained and flagged left/right-censored in the per-run report
episode_definition.dwell: run length in H4 bars; also reported in days (bars * 4h)
episode_definition.threshold_counts: counts of RAW runs with length >= 6, >= 24, >= 72 H4 bars
episode_definition.decisions_per_episode: run length in H4 bars (one eligible decision per bar close; fill next bar open)

merge_rule.primary: iteratively merge two adjacent primary-label runs iff the gap between them consists ONLY of TRANSITION_UNKNOWN bars AND the gap length < 12 H4 bars; repeat left-to-right until fixpoint. Runs separated by any ACCUMULATION/UPTREND/DISTRIBUTION bar are never merged; any gap >= 12 bars is never merged.
merge_rule.secondary_lens: the lens is binary (no TRANSITION_UNKNOWN): merge two adjacent lens runs iff the gap length < 12 H4 bars regardless of gap content.
merge_rule.merged_count: number of runs after merging = the INDEPENDENT-EPISODE estimate reported to the floors

floors_evaluation.fold_law: F_i = ERA-Bi boundaries (post-warmup) via pipeline.census.era_fold_assignment; folds F1..F4
floors_evaluation.evaluation: PASS/FAIL per floor for phase DOWNTREND under (a) RAW runs (PSV1 census convention, runs clipped at fold boundaries for fold-level counts) and (b) MERGED runs (independent-episode estimate, merged within each fold for fold-level counts). Reported for the primary label; the secondary lens is reported descriptively, not floor-adjudicated.

per_run_report.fields: start/end bucket open UTC, run length, days, censored flags, fold(s) spanned, BTC close-to-close return over the run = close[last]/close[start] - 1 (DESCRIPTIVE PRICE OBSERVATION ONLY — this is a property of BTC over the window, not a strategy result; no PnL, no costs, no positions are computed)

outcome_blindness: counts / occupancy / dwell / transitions / descriptive price returns only. No strategy returns, equity path, costs application or parameter search exists in this census. The counting rule above was fixed before the single census run.
